svg.title: Wingthing local MCP workflow
svg.desc: Illustrated commands to start a local wing, connect Codex and inspect a durable agent run. This is an illustration, not a runtime receipt.

g.text: $ codex mcp add wingthing -- wt mcp stdio --client codex
Ask: call wingthing_capabilities, then start an agent run.
Inspect its result with agent_status and agent_result.
Illustrated workflow · see GitLab tag jobs for build evidence
